definitions: An exclamation of surprise or amazement, often used ironically, when something unexpected or unusual happens.
Used to express that one is surprised by an event, often implying that it was thought unlikely to occur.
examples: He actually cleaned his room without being asked; wonders will never cease!
She arrived on time for once, wonders will never cease.
Wonders will never cease, they finally fixed the elevator.
synonyms: you could have knocked me over with a feather
